decision: GO for one root-owned official private check of the frozen source; no promotion claim
root_independent_cpu_pass: Root reported the same frozen targeted proof passed; no duplicate full model execution by this reviewer.
source_findings: The complete diff is exactly one lg unroll hint and a unique extension prefix. All executable statements, packing, producer, geometry, dispatch and non-WGS code are unchanged.
FIRST true requests full four-iteration unroll; FIRST false requests no unroll. h and jj remain unrolled with GS2, so ci=2*lg+h keeps af parity and NTT1 accumulator selection dependent only on h.
The lg loop and its bounds are uniform across a participating warpgroup. Weight arrival remains at lg3 after the last code load; previous-X release remains after wait1 at ci0 only.
First-stage mma0 for both NTT1 accumulators, FCI3 flush, wait1 ordering, final wait0 and final X release remain unchanged. No new collective or shared lifetime is introduced.
The source and finite trace proof do not establish NVCC pragma compliance, allocation, outlined calls, WGMMA serialization or actual GPU correctness/performance. Those remain experiment outcomes.

proof_scope.limits: Model binds source schedule and conservative group retirement, not arbitrary GPU interleavings/global grid progress; inherited global zero-job limitation remains.

evidence_limits: Parent 340480-byte BIG1 text is total code, not a measured instruction-cache hot set or bottleneck.
No extra SASS collector is required for the private check. A score cannot prove why code generation changed.
Any future bounded owned-symbol code-only dump can establish size/loop structure; static instruction counts cannot establish dynamic stall or speedup.
